newsitem.title: USA: Pittway says faces strong competition.
newsitem.headline: Pittway says faces strong competition.

text.p: Pittway Corp said Monday that second-quarter results were favorable, but it faces strong competition in most major domestic and international markets.

"Competitive pressures, the strength of the dollar and an expanded manufacturing capacity to meet future requirements are all proving to make increased profits at the present time a formidable challenge overseas," Pittway said.

The maker of burglar and fire alarms and other products reported a 25-percent increase in second-quarter sales to $339.2 million and a 32-percent increase in net income to $16.6 million from results posted a year ago.
